# Jotirmoy Bhowmik

> Full-stack developer and founder-minded builder based in Rajshahi, Bangladesh. Co-founder at Hylith.

## Who is Jotirmoy Bhowmik?

Jotirmoy Bhowmik is a full-stack developer and founder-minded builder based in Rajshahi, Bangladesh. He is co-founder of Hylith and builds SaaS products, NestJS APIs, Kafka microservices and web apps for real businesses. He also works as a web developer at Branta Tech.

Also known as: Jotirmoy, Jotir Bhowmik.

Official portfolio: https://jotirmoy.is-a.dev
About: https://jotirmoy.is-a.dev/about

## Summary

Jotirmoy Bhowmik builds software products from the ground up, not just features, the full thing: idea, architecture and launch. His work covers SaaS, web applications, backend APIs, microservices and automation for online businesses that have outgrown manual workflows. Deep backend craft in NestJS, TypeScript, Kafka and CQRS when systems need to scale; product-minded end-to-end when a business needs something that ships.
